meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 先划分代码库中的功能边界，为每个功能画出带文件行号标注的流程图；再对照各功能找出重复逻辑；然后提出统一架构，并生成可交接给 /make-plan 的计划提示。不修改代码，只产出分析文档和图表。
howto.when: 当你说“找到理想路径”“统一重复系统”，或要求在重构前审计架构时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目的结构画成流程图，标注文件和行号。
say.note: 会先做功能发现，再为每个功能画流程。

say.text: 找出各功能里重复的代码逻辑，出一份对比报告。
say.note: 会生成重复报告，每条结论都引用出处。

say.text: 我要重构前审计架构，并给出一套统一方案。
say.note: 会输出统一架构提案和交接提示。

howto.what_en: Claude maps the codebase into feature flowcharts, detects duplicated logic across features, and writes a unified architecture proposal plus per-system /make-plan prompts. It only produces analysis files and diagrams, no code edits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to 'find the ideal path', to unify duplicated systems, or to audit architecture before a refactor. Starts with feature discovery before further phases.

say_en.text: Draw flowcharts of this project's structure with file and line labels.
say_en.note: Starts with feature discovery, then per-feature flowcharts.

say_en.text: Find duplicated code logic across features and give a comparison report.
say_en.note: Generates a duplication report; every claim cites sources.

say_en.text: Audit the architecture before my refactor and propose one unified plan.
say_en.note: Outputs a unified proposal and handoff prompts.
